Revenue.description: Total sales revenue derived from units sold * average selling price.
Revenue.driver_method: Price-Volume-Mix decomposition (src/analytics/pvm_analyzer.py), scoped to the same (item_id, state_id) as the flagged anomaly so the effects sum exactly to that anomaly's own actual-minus-baseline delta.

GrossMarginPercent.description: Gross profit margin percentage representing profit relative to revenue.
GrossMarginPercent.driver_method: Detected via the same rolling z-score engine as Revenue (AnomalyDetector.run_detection(kpi_name='GrossMarginPercent')); this prototype does not yet decompose margin movement into a PVM-style sub-driver breakdown -- it is explained via evidence_reconciler retrieval (supply/marketing/feedback), a stated scope limitation rather than a fabricated decomposition.

InventoryTurnover.description: Indicates the supply chain efficiency in moving products, computed as monthly COGS / average inventory value.
InventoryTurnover.driver_method: Detected via the same rolling z-score engine as Revenue (AnomalyDetector.run_detection(kpi_name='InventoryTurnover')); same stated scope limitation as GrossMarginPercent above -- no PVM-style decomposition, explained via evidence retrieval instead.

anomaly_z_score.description: Minimum |z-score| against the trailing 8-period baseline for AnomalyDetector to flag a movement as an anomaly at all (analytics/anomaly_detector.py).

severity_critical_z_score.description: |z-score| above which a flagged anomaly is classified CRITICAL rather than WARNING.

abstention_confidence_floor.description: Confidence below this threshold forces abstention regardless of evidence (llm/abstention.py CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD).

abstention_materiality_z_score.description: An anomaly is treated as material enough to require corroborating evidence (or else abstain as 'insufficient evidence') once |z-score| reaches this bar -- deliberately the detector's own significance threshold, not a separate raw percent-move cutoff, since percent size alone is a poor materiality proxy against a low-variance baseline.

evidence_relevance_tiers.high: >= 0.6 cosine similarity to the anomaly-type vocabulary
evidence_relevance_tiers.low: < 0.3 cosine similarity -- treated as background context only, not corroborating evidence

graph_temporal_window_days.description: A feedback record only counts as related to an anomaly if its date falls in this window (retrieval/knowledge_graph.py, retrieval/evidence_reconciler.py) -- kept identical in both modules so 'related to this anomaly' is one consistent policy, not two that can silently disagree.

admin.description: Full-access oversight role for audit and governance review -- deliberately granted every column both other roles are scoped to, rather than bypassing the entitlements model. Used to verify masking behaves as specified for vp_sales/supply_planner by comparing against the unredacted ground truth.
